other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations like scaling or clustering are applied to the entire training dataset before it is split into cross-validation folds. This leaks distribution statistics from the validation folds into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage via LabelEncoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits a categorical encoder on a concatenation of the training and test datasets. While this avoids errors with unseen categories, it technically leaks knowledge of the test set's categorical distribution into the training pipeline.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with sophisticated feature engineering, appropriate model selection, and an optimized ensemble. However, it suffers from cross-validation leakage by applying StandardScaler and KMeans clustering to the entire training set prior to the StratifiedKFold splits. Additionally, the use of a randomized split on temporal data may introduce look-ahead bias.
